direction: Switch from pure construction (postprocess="none", stuck at ~16.1441 mean across rounds r0001/r0002 with only 0.79% VBS gap and no SBS improvement) to post-merge inter-route local search: keep the global-scale normalized generalized savings hook (lam in [1.00,1.15], mu in [0.08,0.15], beta fill reward in [0.05,0.15]) but co-evolve it so it produces a merge sequence that is a *good L2 starting point* for relocate+2opt — i.e. slightly more capacity-filling merges (higher beta) and weaker triangle-inequality-exploiting long-edge preference (lower lam) to leave fewer, more balanced routes that inter-route 1-0 relocate can profitably fix, targeting the clustered / eccentric-depot / tight-capacity weak regimes.

operations.mechanism: Rounds 1-2 both ran the L2a template with postprocess_mode="none" and produced statistically indistinguishable means (16.1441 vs 16.1445, delta +0.0004), while the VBS over those same two solvers is 0.79% lower than the SBS — so parameter-only re-evolution inside the construction layer is saturating. The KB entry's own open item ("未确认项") flags that L2a was only ever evaluated with postprocess="none", leaving the residual gain of an evolved merge start under local search untested. Meanwhile the KB documents that the static hook is the one part of the L2a family with a large budget margin at 25 ms (p50 2.45 ms, 0 timeouts) precisely because scoring is a single vectorized pre-pass — the opposite of the L2b dynamic variant whose per-merge refresh caused 40/120 budget-exhaustion degradations at 25 ms. That asymmetry is exactly what makes relocate_2opt affordable here: the postprocess gets ~23 ms of slack. The weakest regimes reported by the archive (clustered 8 instances, eccentric depot 12, uniform demand 12, size-100 12, tight capacity 12, all ~-19% to -22% VBS relative gap) are route-structure deficits (fragmented/misbalanced routes at tight capacity), which is the regime where 1-0 relocate is the strongest of the cheap neighbourhoods, and 2-opt cleans the intra-route damage caused by moving a node between routes. All five-gate interface constraints are respected: the hook signature score_merge_static(distance_matrix, demands, capacity, i_idx, j_idx) is unchanged and the global scale mean(d[0,1:]) normalization is retained (the documented pitfall, per-pair (d0i+d0j) normalization degrading dev_24 to ~18.0, is avoided).

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: H3 (residual-gain): Because the L2a static merge hook costs only ~0.3-1.3 ms of the 25 ms budget (p50 select_64 = 2.45 ms total, 100% completion at 25 ms per KB method-cvrp-m2-l2a-generalized-savings), the merged solution enters local search with >90% of the budget unused; therefore attaching relocate_2opt (capacity-guarded 1-0 inter-route relocate alternating with intra-route 2-opt) will recover the residual inter-route fragmentation that pure construction cannot fix, lowering dev_24 mean objective below the 16.1441 plateau — with the effect concentrated in the clustered, eccentric-depot and tight-capacity regimes — without triggering budget-exhaustion degradation of the kind seen for the L2b dynamic-refresh variant at 25 ms (method-cvrp-m2-l2b-dynamic-state-merge).
